verdict.rationale: Unreal ships official command-line tooling (UnrealEditor.exe/UAT) for cooking, packaging, testing and building without the GUI, plus Python scripting for editor automation — all standard building blocks for CI pipelines (unreal-docs-7,14,16,17,30,31,32,36,29,28,26,35). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions/Jenkins examples) and explicit documentation of a fully headless (no window) server/editor mode confirmed by third parties.
